attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his essay 'The Subprime AI Crisis' (2024-09-16). He makes the prediction himself, not quoting anyone.

semantics.note: Unhedged 'will' about a definite outcome, so it is a scored forecast. Reading 'sin of lust' as AI spending and 'big tech' as Microsoft, Amazon and Google fits the context. The latest quarter he named sets the horizon at Q1 2025.

contract.note: The criteria follow his words, but he gave no measure of 'punishing', no window for comparing with NVIDIA, and no way to show investors' motive. The result depends on choices the evaluator would have to make.

output.rationale: The deadline (end of Q1 2025) has passed, so the forecast is due to be scored. The packet has no evidence items: no share-price, valuation or capex-reaction data for Microsoft, Amazon, Google or NVIDIA. With no outcome evidence, the packet can neither support nor contradict the claim, so it stays unresolved. The contract also leaves the measure and comparison window open.
